brief: Identify a guarantor’s obligation from a plainly stated guarantee agreement.

en-US.scenario: Fictional US-dollar examples for "Guarantee Obligations"; illustrative amounts, not current prices or product offers. No assumption of salary, bank ownership or spare income.

es-MX.scenario: Ejemplos ficticios en pesos mexicanos para "Lee promesa de quien garantiza"; montos ilustrativos, no precios vigentes ni ofertas. No se supone nómina, cuenta bancaria ni dinero sobrante.

pt-BR.scenario: Exemplos fictícios em reais para "Leia promessa de quem garante"; valores ilustrativos, não preços atuais nem ofertas. Sem supor salário, conta bancária ou dinheiro sobrando.

objective.observable_action: Identify a guarantor’s obligation from a plainly stated guarantee agreement.
objective.success_criterion: Complete the fresh-context transfer using only its visible information.

instruction.relevance: Guarantees can create payment duties for another person’s borrowing; read the trigger, scope and end conditions.
instruction.misconception: A guarantor only provides a reference and never has to pay, or any private promise releases a signed guarantee.
instruction.numeracy_support: Use only the visible fictional amounts and conditions; earlier arithmetic is preparation, not a hidden financial assumption.

evidence.reasoning: Identify what triggers the guarantee, what debt it covers, and how it ends. A signature may create real payment duties.
The stated trigger creates a payment duty for the guarantor.
The written scope limits this guarantee to loan A.
The stated release condition has not been met.
Missing scope terms leave the possible payment obligation unclear.
Trust does not remove the written payment obligation.
The stated missed-rent trigger activates the defined guarantee.

delayed_retrieval.fresh_context: Retrieve this competence in the declared later course reviews and through the existing shared review system.

en-US.line: Guarantees can create payment duties for another person’s borrowing; read the trigger, scope and end conditions.

pt-BR.line: Garantia pode criar dever de pagar empréstimo alheio; leia quando vale, alcance e fim antes de supor.

en-US.line: Identify what triggers the guarantee, what debt it covers, and how it ends. A signature may create real payment duties.

es-MX.line: Identifica qué activa garantía, qué deuda cubre y cómo termina. Firma puede crear deberes reales de pago.

pt-BR.line: Identifique o que aciona garantia, que dívida cobre e como termina. Assinatura pode criar deveres reais de pagar.

en-US.scene: Fictional guarantee: if borrower misses payment, guarantor must pay that covered amount.
help: Read the obligation written in the agreement.

feedback.met: The stated trigger creates a payment duty for the guarantor.
feedback.not_yet: Read the obligation written in the agreement.

feedback.met: Condición indicada crea deber de pago para garante.

pt-BR.scene: Garantia fictícia: se devedor omite pagamento dado, fiador deve pagar esse valor coberto.

feedback.met: Condição dada cria dever de pagamento para fiador.

en-US.prompt: Which debt does this guarantee cover?
en-US.scene: Fictional guarantee covers only loan A; later loan B is explicitly excluded.
help: Use the actual scope, not an assumed unlimited promise.

feedback.met: The written scope limits this guarantee to loan A.
feedback.not_yet: Use the actual scope, not an assumed unlimited promise.

feedback.not_yet: Usa alcance real, no promesa ilimitada supuesta.

pt-BR.scene: Acordo fictício cobre só empréstimo A; exclui de modo claro empréstimo B posterior.

feedback.met: Alcance escrito limita garantia ao empréstimo A.
feedback.not_yet: Use alcance real, não promessa ilimitada suposta.

en-US.prompt: Does this private promise end the stated guarantee?
en-US.scene: Agreement requires lender’s written release; borrower privately says the guarantor is released.
help: Check who can release the guarantee and how.

feedback.met: The stated release condition has not been met.
feedback.not_yet: Check who can release the guarantee and how.

feedback.met: Condición indicada de liberación no se cumplió.
feedback.not_yet: Revisa quién puede liberar garantía y cómo.

pt-BR.scene: Acordo exige liberação escrita do credor; devedor diz em privado que fiador está livre.

feedback.not_yet: Veja quem pode liberar garantia e como.

help: Verify covered principal, costs and applicable limits.
